title: Greetings and responses
label: ch:persian-greetings
canDo: I can greet someone in Persian, respond courteously, answer yes or no, and copy one alef with a visible model.

payoff.summary: Hold a four-line greeting exchange, point to its right-to-left start, and copy one alef beside the visible model.
payoff.note: The schema-v2 opener and two-minute alef bridge introduce four measurable atoms, all revisited by FA-C01-practice. Mamnoon, bale and na remain legacy whole-word supports and are not falsely represented as typed atoms yet.
